post_text:
Christian Gradnitzer is turning Mandarin Oriental's Food & Beverage into Restaurants, Bars & Experiences.

F&B is gone. Since 3 November, @Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group calls it RB&E. No more hotel "outlets": every restaurant and bar must be worth the trip on its own.

The man behind it, @Christian Gradnitzer, Group Director RB&E, has done this before. Trained as a chef in Austria, he went from The Dorchester to Burj Al Arab, then built Jumeirah's restaurants and bars division in 2014. Group CEO @Laurent Kleitman brought him in last year. @James Norman now runs RB&E for Europe and the Americas.

He starts with 33 Michelin stars, from @Chef Fei's two-star The Bay in Shenzhen to OPUS by @Alessio Durante. Next: Hong Kong, where 14 venues are being reworked, starting with The Pizza Bar by @Daniele Cason and the whisky salon Thistle & Jade.

His line: "Craft differentiates us, but execution earns trust."

The signal: a hotel restaurant is now judged like any address in town.

Would you book a hotel restaurant if you weren't staying at the hotel?

Read the full article: https://hospitality-signals.com/signal-of-the-week/2026-11-06-mandarin-oriental-restaurants-bars-experiences/
